correctness.rationale: For arbitrary focal i, if own s>=high tier and m<2n, some MMS part has <=1 good and value <=s. If s<high, EFX forces every high good to be a foreign singleton. If p high goods, n-p low-only bundles have at most (n-p)(t+1)-1 low goods, whereas any partition with n parts all >t*low requires >=(n-p)(t+1) low goods. Hence MMS<=s. Sharp m=2n witness gives n-1 pairs of high-3 goods and a single pair of low-2 goods; an alternative partition gives focal MMS>=5>4. Exact integer checker verified 893790 finite count configurations and 4 sharpness witnesses.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the first possible cardinality regime of exact EFX/MMS incompatibility across all positive personalized two-tier profiles and all n, plus an agentwise high-tier barrier valid without any good-count bound. This is a natural exact all-allocations compatibility boundary rather than a known-table recomputation or an artificial finite slice. The 2018 sharpness obstruction makes the positive threshold mathematically meaningful, and known EF1 limitations show strength is specific to EFX.
